root_cause: Paperwork treated allocating a one-time deposit address as a refresh/read and allocated again during wallet preflight. The pinned platform creates a new idempotency key for each deposit call.
fix: Job-mutex serialization; valid saved instructions reused; durable existing event row before first allocation; successful response and completion event atomically saved; uncertain/expired/missing resolved instructions refuse replacement. No schema changes.

checks.full_suite: 1582 pass, 0 fail, 10602 assertions across 71 files; final reviewed code

limitations: Platform unknown outcome/cause remains unverified; read-only owner reconciliation prompt prepared but not sent.
Lost original allocation cannot be recovered/replayed through a client request ID in the pinned interface; no reset/retry bypass added.
Old deployed 3ee5b41 still has the address-churn bug. No new deployment authorized by this investigation.
No live deposit allocation, wallet opening, signature, funding or payment performed.

review_findings.finding: Pending-allocation lookup and durable claim must be atomic across database connections.
review_findings.resolution: Moved both into one SQLite transaction before external I/O, retaining the job mutex.
